services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Kayak both sides of Scorpion Anchorage through stunning sea caves, kelp forests, and pristine coastlines. Keep an eye out for vibrant marine life in this marine-protected area (MPA) on this world-class adventure. Paddle the east or west side of Scorpion Anchorage, exploring sea caves, kelp forests, and endemic wildlife. Great for first-timers looking to hike and snorkel before/after the tour. Explore many incredible sea caves enroute to Potato Harbor, a remote area of the park with an aqua-colored cove and pristine shoreline on our longest kayak adventure. See the best of Channel Islands both above and below the surface. Activities include kayaking through stunning sea caves and snorkeling

services.name: Snorkel Rentals
services.desc: Explore the island’s thriving underwater ecosystem with our experienced naturalist guides. Get up close with marine life while learning about the island’s ecology and rich natural history. See the best of Channel Islands both above and below the surface. Activities include kayaking through stunning sea caves and snorkeling in giant kelp forests. Snorkel rentals available at storefront. We accept all major credit cards, but do not accept cash for snorkel rentals. All snorkel rentals include a flotation belt.
